name: Enterprise Legal Identity, Registration and Presence
constraints: WM-ORG-001 is the sole organization-subject identity and continuity master.
WM-ORG-010 owns registration records and never creates or merges subjects during ingestion.
WM-ORG-011 owns operating-presence facts and asserts no legal standing.
Each registration record references exactly one subject after explicit evidenced resolution.
Identifier equality requires the same scheme, issuing namespace and overlapping validity.
Subject status, registration status and evidence-extract observations remain distinct.
Branches separate subject, registration, head-office attribution and operating presence.
Succession appends continuity edges and never rewrites historical contract parties or identifiers.
Effective, authority-recorded and observed times remain separate.
